summary: PII-safe logging and product-event surface whose shipped default is a no-op recorder, so a slot collects nothing until it opts in.
policyNotes: The default implementation sends nothing, so a slot that keeps it must answer Data safety with 'no data collected'.

A slot that replaces the default with a networked analytics or crash-reporting SDK must update this manifest (dataCollected and sdkDependencies), the Play Data safety form and the privacy policy in the same change.

Never pass user content, account identifiers, advertising identifiers, e-mail addresses or free-form user text to log() or event(); Redaction.scrub only masks the common shapes and is a safety net, not a licence.
